description: Unmet deficit from previous week, carried forward
label: Carried Deficit (mm)
name: Irrigation Planner-carried_deficit_mm

description: Water depth each block actually receives this week
label: Delivered Depth (mm)
name: Irrigation Planner-delivered_depth_mm

description: Deficit not met this week, carries to next week
label: Unmet Deficit (mm)
name: Irrigation Planner-unmet_deficit_mm

description: Did this shift actually run? Operator marks after the fact.
label: Actually Irrigated
name: Irrigation Planner-actually_irrigated

description: Required if actually_irrigated is unchecked.
label: Skip Reason
name: Irrigation Planner-skip_reason
options:
Rain
Pump down
Power outage
No labour
Valve issue
Other

description: Free-form notes by the operator after the shift.
label: Operator Notes
name: Irrigation Planner-operator_notes

description: Number of equal back-to-back cycles this shift is split into.
label: Cycles
name: Irrigation Planner-cycles_count

description: Human-readable summary, e.g. "3 × 4.50 hr".
label: Cycle Plan
name: Irrigation Planner-cycle_plan

description: Shown under the product name in the /upande-irrigation header, e.g. the estate or group this deployment belongs to. Leave blank to show nothing.
label: Organisation Name
name: Irrigation Settings-organisation_name

description: Hours needed to meet demand, before pump capping. Compare with Shift Hours.
label: Required Hours
name: Irrigation Planner-required_hours

description: Start of the elapsed week this demand was measured over.
label: Measured From
name: Irrigation Planner-measured_from

description: End of that week — always the day before From Date.
label: Measured To
name: Irrigation Planner-measured_to

description: Below this many daily readings in the measured week, no planner is created for that farm-week and the run records why. 7 refuses on a single missed day.
label: Minimum Weather Readings per Week
name: Irrigation Settings-min_weather_days

description: Gap between a shift's cycles, so water can infiltrate before the next one.
label: Rest Between Cycles (Hrs)
name: Irrigation Settings-cycle_rest_hours

description: Used when a section has no Irrigation Pump Profile.
label: Default Pump Flow Rate (m³/hr)
name: Irrigation Settings-default_pump_flow_rate_m3_per_hr

description: Weekly volume a pump may deliver. Divided by the flow rate this gives the weekly hour budget — 3500 ÷ 25 = 140 hr/wk, i.e. 20 h/day.
label: Default Water Target (m³/week)
name: Irrigation Settings-default_water_target_m3_per_week

description: Emitter output for this shift. Leave blank or 0 to inherit the farm default from Irrigation Settings.
label: Application Rate (mm/hr)
name: Block Type-application_rate_mm_hr

description: Fraction of the ground the emitters wet. Leave blank or 0 to inherit the farm default.
label: Irrigation Coverage (%)
name: Block Type-irrigation_coverage

description: The rate this planner's hours were computed with.
label: Applied Rate (mm/hr)
name: Irrigation Planner-applied_rate_mm_hr

description: The coverage this planner's hours were computed with.
label: Applied Coverage (%)
name: Irrigation Planner-applied_coverage_pct
